name: BookStack
description: Organize knowledge in Books > Chapters > Pages. WYSIWYG editor, roles & permissions, image management, export to PDF.
compose:
services:
  bookstack:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/bookstack:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      APP_URL: "${{cfg.app_url}}"
      DATABASE_HOST: "bookstack-db"
      DATABASE_USER: "bookstack"
      DATABASE_PASSWORD: "bookstack"
      DATABASE_DATABASE: "bookstack"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
    depends_on:
      - bookstack-db
    restart: unless-stopped
  bookstack-db:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/mariadb:latest
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: "bookstackroot"
      MYSQL_DATABASE: "bookstack"
      MYSQL_USER: "bookstack"
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: "bookstack"
    volumes:
      - ./db:/config
    restart: unless-stopped
